title: Bounded warm-process preparation API profile

protocol.trusted_fixture: independent two-file Git fixture, not the fresh20 corpus
protocol.setup: actual Service(watch=False), approval and initial production indexing measured separately
protocol.skip_order: seeded shuffled collection of 500 calls per bypass; seed 20261017
protocol.state: warm Python process and warm local filesystem/cache after fixture setup
protocol.shared_host_control: runner/corpus tests briefly paused; root frontend finished; other host activity and provider/OS caches not controlled
protocol.timing_boundary: outer perf_counter_ns/process_time_ns directly around prepare_prompt; returned internal times also preserved
protocol.cpu_scope: current Python process only; setup subprocess CPU excluded
protocol.zero_auxiliary_call_evidence: implementation inspection and existing guarded preparation/launcher tests; profile does not claim general OS syscall telemetry

interpretation: Component measurements only. No model token/cost saving or whole-task latency advantage can be inferred.
